# Di Dee Designers

> Di Dee Designers is a saree pre-pleating and box folding service in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India. It pleats and box-folds the customer's own saree in advance so it can be worn in minutes without arranging pleats by hand. Silk, bridal and delicate sarees are handled with personal care, with scheduled pickup and doorstep delivery across Tiruppur, Avinashi and Erode. Di Dee Designers prepares sarees; it does not sell them.

## Prices (per saree, INR)
- Box folding (pressed pleats): ₹250 - everyday and office sarees
- Semi-fluffy pleats: ₹300 - functions and festivals
- Full-fluffy pleats with hanger: ₹400 - weddings and bridal sarees
- Final price is confirmed on WhatsApp before booking.

## Services
- Saree pre-pleating and box folding
- Silk and bridal saree preparation
- Pleating to your style
- Scheduled pickup and doorstep delivery (Tiruppur, Avinashi, Erode)
- Family and bulk orders, including packages for makeup artists, parlours, saree shops and boutiques
- Express preparation (subject to availability)

## How to book
1. Message +91 90030 37820 on WhatsApp with location, occasion date, saree type and quantity.
2. Get the price, availability and pickup or delivery options.
3. Hand over the saree or set up a scheduled pickup.
4. Collect the pre-pleated, box-folded saree or receive it by delivery.

## Contact
- Business name: Di Dee Designers
- Business location: Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90030 37820
